title: feat(festivals-calendar): implement Enterprise Indian Festivals & Cultural Calendar Explorer Suite
body:
### Summary
This issue tracks the implementation of the **Enterprise Indian Festivals & Cultural Calendar Explorer Suite** — an interactive dashboard for exploring India's festivals, cultural events, and holiday traditions.

### Features Implemented
- 🎉 **Festival Explorer** — 16 major festivals with season, month, origin, and ritual metadata
- 📅 **Monthly Calendar** — 12-month breakdown with quarterly filtering
- 🏮 **Cultural Traditions Database** — 14 traditions across Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Christian, and Buddhist origins
- 📊 **Analytics Dashboard** — Seasonal distribution, monthly counts, religious breakdown, and heritage timeline
- 🔍 **Global Search & Filter** — Multi-term fuzzy search with category filters, sub-filters, and sorting

### Technical Details
- **HTML** (292 lines): Glassmorphic dark-mode dashboard with ARIA landmarks and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
- **CSS** (625 lines): Responsive glassmorphic styling with CSS custom properties, rangoli-pattern hero, and mobile breakpoints
- **JavaScript** (644 lines): Class-based `FestivalEngine` with filtering, sorting, search, and analytics
- **Tests** (556 lines): 68 Vitest unit tests covering all engine methods, models, filters, analytics, and render functions

### Total Line Count: 2,117 lines

### Labels & Keywords
`festivals`, `cultural-calendar`, `indian-heritage`, `frontend`, `dashboard`, `analytics`, `ready-for-review`
